# BitConcepts

> BitConcepts, LLC is a Michigan engineering company. Its consulting and
> engineering services are now delivered through ElectroHire.
> BitConcepts owns and runs the Indus decipherment research program
> (Glossa-Lab); this site is the program's public front door.

## Consulting

- All BitConcepts consulting and engineering services are delivered
  through ElectroHire: https://electrohire.com/
- Contact for consulting: https://electrohire.com/

## Research

- Indus decipherment research is a BitConcepts program. The program
  tests claims about the Indus script one by one against
  pre-registered criteria; the script is not deciphered, and negative
  results are published at the same prominence as positive ones.
- Research home (all programs): https://bitconcepts.tech/research/
- Public record — Indus Program Tracker:
  https://bitconcepts.tech/research/indus-script/
- Latest release: Zenodo v5.2.0 (October 20, 2026),
  DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23520218 — https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23520218
- Project record on OSF: https://osf.io/ybd65
- Related research — the Axiovex Systems research hub (sister
  program; the same evidence-first method applied to fundamental
  physics): https://axiovexsystems.com/research/
- Program repository: https://github.com/BitConcepts/glossa-lab
- GitHub organization: https://github.com/BitConcepts
